entries.3ef18f940d1a7be9: A reportable segment that provides consulting on opening and operating accommodation facilities that make use of vacant houses and vacant vacation homes, and sells accommodation facilities, carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Housebird Co., Ltd. It extends integrated support across Japan, from proposing properties to developing accommodation facility concepts, supporting design and construction, and operations management. In selling accommodation facilities, it sells detached houses (buildings with land) intended for ryokan business, handled by its integrated in-house system from land purchase through planning, design, construction management and sales, to general consumers, corporations and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it won 16 consulting contracts across Japan, including in Azumino, Nagano Prefecture, and revenue was ¥390,130 thousand (up 267.6% from the previous year). However, because consulting contract orders fell short of expectations, the segment loss was ¥28,705 thousand (compared with an ordinary loss of ¥28,067 thousand in the previous year). Housebird Co., Ltd. changed its fiscal year-end, and 14 months were consolidated for the fiscal year ended March 2026.

entries.c81a4807397cf2ef: The group's main reportable segment, which sells detached houses and detached-house land (residential lots) under its own "Agratio" brand series, mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area of Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama and Chiba. It handles everything from purchasing detached-house land to block planning, building planning and design, construction management, sales and after-sales maintenance, and for most detached-house projects its employees explain directly to customers and sell on its own, without going through real estate brokers. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥30,368,151 thousand (up 12.3% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥3,283,413 thousand (up 17.3%). It delivered 376 detached houses, 16 detached-house lots and 2 other units such as custom-built houses, and the average price of a detached house was ¥75,865 thousand. As of the end of the current consolidated fiscal year, it supplies detached houses from 4 locations: the Shinjuku, Kichijoji, Shibuya and Tokyo branches.

entries.d30974d27fcb9a4d: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the Group (the Company and one consolidated subsidiary) operates three [[term:segment|segments]] targeting the Tokyo metropolitan area, centered on Tokyo's special wards: the Housing Business, which sells detached houses and land for detached houses; the Asset Solution Business, which sells income-generating condominiums and apartments and condominium sites, etc.; and the Accommodation Business, which provides consulting on opening and operating accommodation facilities using vacant houses and vacant holiday homes, etc. The core Housing Business handles everything in-house, from acquiring detached-house land and planning the blocks to designing buildings, construction management, sales and after-sales maintenance, and it adopts in-house sales in which employees explain directly to customers without going through real estate brokers. Revenue is recognized when a property is delivered, and because land acquisition and condominium construction funds are mainly raised through borrowings from financial institutions, the annual securities report states that the company has a high dependence on interest-bearing debt. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36,975,239 thousand.

entries.e0a930888e873d7a: A reportable segment that builds and sells income-producing condominiums and apartments for investors, and sells condominium land and similar sites, mainly in scarce areas of central Tokyo. It was newly established in April 2019 to meet real estate needs other than the Housing Business. It focuses on highly designed product planning cultivated in the Housing Business, and the asset consulting team newly established in July 2024 provides services such as support for selling owned properties and the sale and rental management of investment condominiums and apartments. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it delivered 7 income-producing condominiums, 6 income-producing apartments, 15 lots of condominium land and similar sites, and other properties, with revenue of ¥6,217,082 thousand (up 73.2% from the previous year) and segment profit of ¥610,389 thousand (up 70.4%). As noted in the securities report, this revenue includes internal sales between segments. Real estate leasing and management are also carried out incidentally to the business.
